docs: Adapted from Gauge UI by Thordur (MIT): https://github.com/thordursk/gauge-ui. See NOTICE. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite gauge-kit, button, slider, switch, select, popover, tooltip, or sheet. Stage colors are primary, foreground, muted, background, destructive, and chart-1 through chart-5, plus a custom colour. Spring motion keeps the readout and the needle on the same value. Motion snaps when reduced motion is set. Undo and redo are Control or Command Z.
